## New candidates

`Adopt` means the user outcome and integration are ready to become a focused
issue. `Experiment` allows a time-boxed, non-default spike. `Watch` records a
promising option with a concrete revisit trigger. `No action` prevents the same
announcement from being repeatedly reconsidered without new evidence.

| Provider/model | Text | Vision | Image | Structured output/tools | Local hardware or remote data path | License/availability/cost shape | Decision and why |
| -------------- | ---- | ------ | ----- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------- |
|                |      |        |       |                         |                                    |                                 |                  |

## QuestKeeper fit

- [ ] The candidate maps to explicit provider capabilities instead of
      provider-name branches.
- [ ] Local and remote behavior, consent and transmitted scope are clear.
- [ ] No provider or model becomes an automatic fallback or default silently.
- [ ] Credentials remain in the existing protected configuration boundary.
- [ ] Model selection remains available at task time where the workflow
      requires it.
- [ ] The option works with manual authoring and does not make AI mandatory.
- [ ] Regional availability, data retention, licensing and redistribution were
      checked.
- [ ] Required RAM/CPU/GPU or API costs can be explained before installation or
      execution.
- [ ] Shared changes can be validated in the public demo, Phandelver and Curse
      of Strahd without copying campaign content.

## Closeout

- [ ] Updated the provider research matrix with dated official sources.
- [ ] Opened focused issues only for actionable user outcomes.
- [ ] Recorded deprecation deadlines in the next weekly review.
- [ ] Linked privacy, compatibility, release and migration risks.
- [ ] Recorded `no action` and `watch` decisions with revisit triggers.
- [ ] Confirmed that no user configuration or provider default changed during
      this review.
